en.description: Insert clear, customizable page numbers into your PDF documents. Select header or footer positions, custom formatting styles, and margin offsets.

en.formulaDescription: Insert clear, customizable page numbers into your PDF documents. Select header or footer positions, custom formatting styles, and margin offsets.

faqs.question: What page numbering formats are supported?
faqs.answer: You can choose between simple numbers ("1, 2, 3"), "Page 1, Page 2", or total page counts ("Page 1 of 10").

faqs.question: Where can I position the page numbers?
faqs.answer: You can place numbers in 6 positions: Bottom Center, Bottom Right, Bottom Left, Top Center, Top Right, or Top Left.

faqs.question: Can I start numbering from a specific number or skip cover pages?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can set the starting number (e.g., start counting at 1 or 5) and specify custom page ranges to skip title pages.
